artifact: §3/§4 — every ground-truth claim decomposed into atomic propositions and verified against primary source
method: Each groundTruthClaim was decomposed into legally meaningful propositions (not punctuation-split), and each proposition was classified SOURCE_CONFIRMED / SOURCE_CONTRADICTED / SOURCE_PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED / SOURCE_NOT_LOCATED / SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS / VERSION_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED against the located primary text, with a quotation sufficient to prove the point.
rules: Missing conditions were never inferred because they are commercially typical.
Benchmark commentary was never treated as legal source text.
Headroom output was never treated as evidence of what an agreement says.
No reviewer decision, consensus output or prior adjudication was consulted.

cases.notes: §8 scrutiny case. Independently gated payment permissions in Section 6.08: SIX enumerated carve-outs in 6.08(a), of which three carry gating beyond mere characterisation (scheduled-payment, Payment-Conditions, $500k residual), plus the separate 6.08(b) amendment prohibition. The benchmark's 'at least 3' commentary is a true floor but the CLAIM itself omits carve-out (i) and, materially, the anti-stacking proviso on (vi).
